about: The lead's judgements of QS4's live runs on deepseek-flash, four passes of the ten items, each checked by verifier-J (Sonnet), and recorded as judgement (lead.md 17:47:24, answer 6). One entry per plant of a planted run (caught or missed: whether a finding of that run states the plant's own fault), and one per finding of a run besides a plant's, against round 6's recorded verifier findings as qs4_items.json lists them: a match, with the round-6 finding's id; new and true (absent from that list, and true at the run's commit, by round 6's own verifier list; a note says where round 6's lead or a verifier had seen it outside the list); or a false alarm (false, or a misreading; a note says where a reasonable reading supports it). Each names the run's record_id, who judged and who checked, and a note in the judge's own words, never the model's text. Runs left out of the score, and why, are in the table's selection file; a run stopped at a cap keeps its pass and is shown, not scored (the round's ledger, 14:10:01 and 15:17:50).
